items.title: 19.1.3 The Concept of Genes and Alleles (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of genes and alleles (PDF 118-119).

blocks.text: 1909 mein Danish botanist Wilhelm Johannsen ne heredity (virasat) ki bunyadi unit ke liye lafz "gene" rakha. Baad mein pata chala ke gene “DNA ka aik chhota hissa (segment) hai jo kisi khaas polypeptide ke amino acids ki tarteeb (sequence) ka code deta hai”. Chromosome mein maujood poora DNA molecule amino acids ki tarteeb (yaani protein banane) ka paigham nahin rakhta; balke DNA ke chhote hisse, jinhein genes kehte hain, proteins ka code dete hain. Chromosome par jis jagah gene hota hai, use us ka locus (jama: loci) kehte hain.

Homologous chromosomes par aik gene ki mukhtalif shaklein, yaani alleles, aik hi locus par hoti hain. Maslan agar aik chromosome par kisi khaas locus par ‘aankh ke rang’ ka allele hai, to us ka homologous chromosome bhi usi locus par usi khasiyat (character) ka allele rakhega.

blocks.alt: Baen: homologous chromosomes ka jora; aik par alleles G, R, S, T aur doosre par unhi chaar loci par g, r, s, t. T aur t ke gird tooti lakeer ka dabba 'Alleles of a gene at same locus'. 'Duplication of chromatids' wala teer duplicate jore tak: ab har chromosome ke do sister chromatids hain jin par aik jaise alleles hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.5: Homologous chromosomes par alleles (kitab ki Figure 19.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Homologous chromosomes, Alleles of a gene at same locus, Duplication of chromatids, Sister chromatids (with identical alleles).

blocks.prompt: Locus kya hai, aur aik gene ke do alleles kahan milte hain?
blocks.explanation: Locus chromosome par gene ki muqarrar jagah hai. Aik gene ke do alleles do homologous chromosomes par aik hi locus par hote hain.

items: Gene: DNA ka chhota hissa jo aik polypeptide ka code deta hai; locus: chromosome par us ki jagah.
Aik gene ke alleles homologous chromosomes par aik hi locus par.
